en: Color postcard view of a busy industrial harbor canal lined with cargo ships and cranes on both sides. In the foreground is a small pier or landing stage with stairs, railings, a clock, and several small boats moored alongside. Large freighters fly what appears to be a Swedish flag. Warehouses and rail tracks run along the quays, and many lattice cranes dominate the skyline under a clear blue sky.
